description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.021 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Forward and reverse geocoding via OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Forward: convert an address or place name to latitude/longitude, bounding box, and OSM metadata. Reverse: convert lat/lon to a structured street address. Supports any location worldwide. Useful for location enrichment, address validation, coordinate lookup, and building location-aware agent flows.
